about: English Wikipedia’s list of perennial sources, as Vitruvian Manager read it: the standing consensus of Wikipedia’s editors on using each outlet as a source in Wikipedia. It is not Vitruvian Manager’s judgement, not Media Bias/Fact Check’s, and not a rating of any single article.
changes: Vitruvian Manager kept each row’s name, its status and its anchor only, and joined the rows to the Political Briefing’s publishers by their own web addresses and names. It copied none of the list’s summaries, discussions or uses.
